statement.detailedDescription: The cardholder reports a $500.00 purchase from 'GIFTCARDVAULT' for digital gift cards they did not authorize. The cardholder has never used this merchant. Investigation suggests the card data was compromised in a data breach. Multiple gift cards were purchased and instantly redeemed, a pattern consistent with fraud.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: N/A — the cardholder did not make this purchase and has no account with this merchant.
statement.requestedResolution: Full reversal due to fraudulent processing.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4840 (Fraudulent Processing of Transaction).
